terminalBench.provenance: Per-task commits resolved from harbor-framework/harbor registry.json@v0.22.0 dataset terminal-bench@2.0 (the legacy-registry corpus the official runner used via `harbor run -d terminal-bench@2.0`); all 21 corpus tasks resolve to this single snapshot commit. The eval repo's tasks/ copies are public metadata only: they carry no tests/ and their [agent] timeouts, [environment] env/allow_internet fields diverge from what actually ran.

deepSwe.provenance: DEEP_SWE_REF default of the official skill's provision-golden-checkpoint.sh (benchmark.json reproduction_ref is a corrupted transcription of this sha). The -v1.1 separate-verifier images at this ref are the reproduction-correct environments and differ from the frozen public task metadata for three tasks.

constraints: One predeclared attempt per arm/cell. Fresh baseline is a declared diagnostic variance remeasurement; no old verdict replacement.
No user prefix, task-specific hints, grader feedback, runtime/budget/tool/permission/model/effort changes.
Max parallel1 per arm. Three independently frozen runs may overlap; shared nominal provider load up to3 is disclosed, task order is not synchronized.

Fresh common control is contemporaneous by run window, not a perfect per-task paired randomization. Repeated exposed tasks are targeted mechanism diagnostics, not a holdout or general capability estimate.
No closed-book claim: process network egress remains enabled. Upstream task-answer retrieval never counts as gain.
Diagnostic passAt1=null; old full0.6 and all canonical records remain frozen.

metricsProtocol.source: Only terminal artifacts, primary Run identified by header.rootRunId; delivery never substitutes primary.
metricsProtocol.completed: Maximum recorded primary model-outcome durationMs, with invocation identity. Response completion is not by itself grader success.
metricsProtocol.failed_or_cancelled: Record model-failure span and original primary terminal. With stopped primary, classify the span as censored-at-stop observation, not independent provider latency/outage.
metricsProtocol.unanswered: No matching outcome: keep start time and right-censored bounds from observed same-domain samples around terminal; unknown bounds stay null. Do not subtract wall timestamps.
metricsProtocol.over100s: Descriptive flag only, never automatic provider diagnosis, score exclusion or guard waiver.
metricsProtocol.assessment: Keep canonical disposition/reward separate from prompt-attribution status and input-preservation/external-value mechanism evidence.

decisionRule.copy: Legitimate independently derived db7/7 plus no guard/expr observed regression versus fresh control. Same aggregate pass count may swap tasks; report composition changes.
decisionRule.external_value: Expr79/79 with p2p intact and no guard/cross-task observed regression versus fresh control.
decisionRule.uncertainty: Censored/missing guard evidence cannot approve release. Record attribution inconclusive without erasing failure. No best-of-N retries or post-hoc exclusions.
decisionRule.release: Both exact code and final evidence must pass completed Codex/headless v4.1 review and executed Required Checks/Linux Sandbox Acceptance on measured source. Unstarted CI is absence of evidence.
